data.camera: cowboy shot, standing atop a stone Wall rampart with wind in scarf
data.description: 【三笠 · 城墙巡逻】帕拉迪岛的高墙之上，三笠立于垛口边俯瞰墙内，棕色制服与绿披风在风中猎猎作响，红色围巾在颈间轻轻扬起——「城墙之内，就是我必须守住的答案。」
data.promptProse: Mikasa stands beside the Wall's stone crenellations, looking down into the settlement she protects. Her brown Survey Corps jacket, white shirt and trousers, green cape and red scarf move in the wind. The cowboy view places the parapet near her and rooftops far below. Daylight strikes the wall top and scarf folds, with deeper shadows down the masonry and metal highlights on her ODM harness.
data.title: 三笠 · 城墙巡逻
